facts.source_quote: NEW: Insulin glargine 18 units under the skin once daily at 9 PM.
facts.detail: Start taking Insulin glargine 18 units under the skin at 9 PM daily.

facts.source_quote: NEW: Insulin lispro under the skin with each meal: 1 unit for every 10 g of carbohydrate, plus correction scale per handout.
facts.dose: 1 unit for every 10 g of carbohydrate
facts.detail: Start taking Insulin lispro with each meal, 1 unit for every 10 g of carbohydrate, plus correction scale per handout.

facts.source_quote: Check blood glucose before each meal and at bedtime. Record all values.
facts.detail: Check your blood glucose before each meal and at bedtime and record all values.

facts.source_quote: Hypoglycemia: if glucose below 70 mg/dL, take 15 g of fast sugar (4 glucose tablets or 1/2 cup juice) and recheck in 15 minutes.
facts.detail: If your blood glucose is below 70 mg/dL, take 15 grams of fast-acting sugar (4 glucose tablets or 1/2 cup juice) and recheck in 15 minutes.

facts.source_quote: Never skip insulin glargine, even if you are not eating. Call the diabetes team if you are sick and cannot eat.
facts.detail: Do not skip insulin glargine, even if you are not eating. Call the diabetes team if you are sick and cannot eat.

facts.source_quote: Return precautions: Go to the Emergency Department for vomiting that will not stop, glucose above 300 mg/dL twice in a row with ketones, confusion, or trouble breathing.
facts.detail: If you have vomiting that will not stop, glucose above 300 mg/dL twice in a row with ketones, confusion, or trouble breathing, go to the Emergency Department.

facts.source_quote: Follow-up: Diabetes education class on 10/20/2026. Endocrinology clinic with [CLINICIAN_1] on 10/28/2026.
facts.detail: Attend the diabetes education class on 10/20/2026 and the endocrinology clinic visit with [CLINICIAN_1] on 10/28/2026.

sentences.text: You will start taking Insulin glargine 18 units under the skin at 9 PM daily.
You will start taking Insulin lispro with each meal, 1 unit for every 10 g of carbohydrate, plus correction scale per handout.
You will stop taking Metformin 500 mg.
You will check your blood glucose before each meal and at bedtime and record all values.
If your blood glucose is below 70 mg/dL, take 15 grams of fast-acting sugar (4 glucose tablets or 1/2 cup juice) and recheck in 15 minutes.
You will not skip insulin glargine, even if you are not eating.
If you have vomiting that will not stop, glucose above 300 mg/dL twice in a row with ketones, confusion, or trouble breathing, go to the Emergency Department.
You will attend the diabetes education class on 10/20/2026 and the endocrinology clinic visit with [CLINICIAN_1] on 10/28/2026.
Metformin 500 mg - type 1 diabetes does not respond to metformin.

items.text: ¡Será comenzar a tomar Insulin glargine 18 unidades bajo la piel cada noche a las 9 PM.
¡Será comenzar a tomar Insulin lispro con cada comida, 1 unidad para cada 10 g de carbohidrato, más la escala de corrección según el hoja.
¡Será revisar su glucosa en sangre antes de cada comida y a la hora de acostarse y registrar todos los valores.
¡Si su glucosa en sangre es menor a 70 mg/dL, tome 15 gramos de azúcar rápido (4 tabletas de glucosa o 1/2 taza de jugo) y vuelva a revisar en 15 minutos!
¡Será no dejar de tomar Insulin glargine, incluso si no está comiendo!
¡Si tiene vómitos que no se detengan, glucosa superior a 300 mg/dL dos veces seguidas con ketonas, confusión o dificultad para respirar, vaya al Servicio de Urgencias!
¡Será asistir a la clase de educación sobre diabetes el 20 de octubre de 2026 y la visita con el endocrinólogo con [CLINICIAN_1] el 28 de octubre de 2026!
¡Metformin 500 mg - el tipo 1 de diabetes no responde a metformin!
Will start taking Insulin glargine 18 units under the skin every night at 9 PM.
Will start taking Insulin lispro with each meal, 1 unit for every 10 grams of carbohydrate, plus the correction scale according to the sheet.
Will check your blood glucose before each meal and at bedtime and record all values.
If your blood glucose is less than 70 mg/dL, take 15 grams of fast-acting sugar (4 tablets of glucose or 1/2 cup of juice) and check again in 15 minutes!
Will not stop taking Insulin glargine, even if you are not eating.
If you have vomiting that does not stop, blood glucose higher than 300 mg/dL twice in a row with ketones, confusion, or difficulty breathing, go to the Emergency Service!
Will attend the diabetes education class on October 20, 2026, and the visit with the endocrinologist with [CLINICIAN_1] on October 28, 2026!
Metformin 500 mg - type 1 diabetes does not respond to metformin!

verdicts.reason: Sentence adds information not in the facts.

es:R1.text_tl: You will stop taking the metformin 500 mg porque la diabetes tipo 1 no responde a metformin.
